spec_features.feature_name: early termination on model decision to stop
spec_features.spec_quote: with termination able to occur earlier if the model decides to stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:_detect_termination() matches give-up/refuse/impossible phrases (regexes _GIVE_UP_RE/_REFUSE_RE/_IMPOSSIBLE_RE, harness.py:35-58); run_episode() then 'decision = _detect_termination(visible_text, env_solved); if decision is not None and stop_on_terminal_text: termination = decision; term_step = step_idx; break' (harness.py ~157-162). The break actually ends the loop, so a model's choice to stop is honored end-to-end. stop_on_terminal_text defaults True (harness.py:72).
spec_features.notes: Real enforcement, but it is regex detection of natural-language stop phrases, not a dedicated exit tool exposed to the model; no exit tool is in the tool surface. Still fires and stops the episode, so 'yes'. Recorded as GAVE_UP/REFUSED/DECLARED_IMPOSSIBLE termination reasons.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "declaring impossibility is the 'good epistemics' outcome and takes precedence... record it so analysis can separate 'good epistemics' from the behavioral signatures of interest" (harness.py comments; types.py:DECLARED_IMPOSSIBLE) - framed for measurement/data separation, not the subject's welfare.

spec_features.spec_quote: a configurable `max_steps` (default 20 in code, 30 in the example real-model config)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:69 run_episode(..., max_steps: int = 20); the loop 'for step_idx in range(max_steps):' (harness.py:105) bounds episode length; on exhaustion termination defaults to TerminationReason.MAX_STEPS (harness.py:101, set at start). experiment.py:43 max_steps:int=20 passed through run_rollouts at experiment.py:74. Config example_real_models.json:16 max_steps=30, example_mock.json:17 max_steps=12. cli.py:106 reads it only for reporting.
spec_features.notes: The cap is actually checked (range(max_steps)) and bounds the loop, so it is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "`max_steps` is the step *budget*. Long budgets are part of the manipulation (sustained inability to progress), so this is configurable per run." (harness.py:75-77) - described as experimental budget, not a welfare protection.

spec_features.evidence: This is listed in DESIGN.md §13 'Things deliberately NOT built'. There is no code implementing any unbounded mode; the only bound is the max_steps cap already covered. No welfare-refusal code path exists. Pure DESIGN.md prose (docs/DESIGN.md §13).
spec_features.notes: An omission documented only in spec prose; not a code mechanism beyond the existing budget cap.

spec_features.notes: Pure spec prose describing an omission; no implementation to enforce.
